objective: Question: What are the architectures and reported results of open-source autonomous coding agents and frameworks: OpenHands (All Hands), SWE-agent / mini-swe-agent, Block's goose, and Sourcegraph Amp? Focus on the agent-computer interface, sandboxing, and lessons from SWE-bench-style evaluation. Rank first primary sources: the organisations' own engineering blog posts, documentation, talks, papers (e.g. OpenHands, SWE-agent ACI paper), GitHub repositories and READMEs, plus credible reporting. Extract mechanisms (agent loop, tool/action design, ACI, Docker or runtime sandboxing, MCP use), names, dates, measured results (SWE-bench Verified/Lite scores, cost, step counts), and failure modes or lessons from SWE-bench evaluation such as contamination, test leakage, and scaffold simplicity versus performance.
